meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_1H_2506, sat 15 May 2025). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: CROSSOVER BLOCK CONFIRMED: 1F q18-q26 = 1H q1-q9, a contiguous block of nine questions worth 40 marks. Marks match item for item. Coded in the same sitting as IGCSE-JUN25-F-P1 and the shared rows carry identical tags by construction.

q2(b),(c) tagged upper_and_lower_bounds and q6(b) tagged factorising_quadratics / solving_quadratic_equations_factorising. Both are Foundation content on 4MA1 and appear here only because they are in the crossover block. See the Foundation paper's notes.

GAP-CANDIDATE arithmetic_series_sum — q24, 5 marks, 2 of them (M1 Un, M1 Sn) on the series formulae. The sum of an arithmetic series has no node in data/skills.ts. Tagged simultaneous_equations as an INTERIM measure, because the other 3 marks are unambiguously eliminate-and-substitute and a correct answer does demonstrate that; deriveAttempts is positive-only so a wrong answer cannot mis-penalise it. NOT a decision that the skill is unnecessary — user ruling 2026-10-07 is that the question clearly signals arithmetic series and the skill probably should exist, but to gather evidence across the corpus first rather than add a node off one sighting. Each such item opens its note with that prefix exactly once, so the corpus can be counted with a grep. Revisit against minParts=4. See docs/audit/25-igcse-4ma1-delta.md section 2.3.
q10(b) tagged sketching_functions: plotting a cubic from a completed table. plotting_straight_line_graphs would be a false claim about the curve.
q13 tagged growth_and_decay first: two successive percentage decreases, then percentage_change to recover the third year's unknown percentage increase.
q20 needs BOTH rules: the mark scheme applies the cosine rule to find BD, then the sine rule to reach BC. Tagged in that order.
q14(a) completing a probability tree is NOT flagged visual: the branch structure restates in a sentence, per the rule of thumb in docs/coding-a-paper.md.
